description: Due-date calculator: add or subtract N business days from a date, skipping weekends and nationwide public holidays for a country (ISO code). Returns the result date and weekday, which holidays were skipped and whether the start day is a working day. For SLAs, invoice terms, shipping and legal deadlines. Price $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"start":"2026-12-23","start_weekday":"Wednesday","start_is_business_day":true,"days":5,"result":"2026-12-31","result_weekday":"Thursday","calendar_days":8,"weekend_days_skipped":2,"holidays_skipped":[{"date":"2026-12-25","name":"Christmas Day"}],"country":"US"}

days.description: Whole number of business days, negative to go back (max 1000)

name: business_day_add
